entries.98e7041665e85ba2: In the Petroleum Business, the company has a procurement system based on continuing sales and purchase agreements with ENEOS, a subsidiary of ENEOS Holdings, which is its major shareholder. The operating base of the Recycling Business covers all of Hokkaido, and it has a collection network for waste oil and waste materials. The Himeji Plant, established in November 2025, is a production base that introduced technology first in Japan for biofuel production facilities, including a blender that can variably adjust the blending ratio of biomaterials from 1% to 99%.
entries.9cc3314255014d0b: Under a long-term vision of 'contributing to society through greening the environment and the stable supply of energy,' and in conjunction with the transition to a holding company structure, the company reorganized its business portfolio into three domains: green, energy and infrastructure. The company focuses on formulating group management strategy and on M&A and new business creation centered on the recycling business, while operating companies concentrate on business operations. In the green domain, it is strengthening its foundation through the acquisition of Yūgen Kaisha Kashima as a subsidiary and the establishment of a biofuel production base in Himeji City, and is considering strengthening sales of environmentally friendly fuels such as recycled heavy oil.
